about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey in Tales of Aradia, a rich idle RPG where every click, every choice, and every moment of offline progression shapes your legend. Discover the sprawling realm of Aradia—home to ancient forests, hidden dungeons, bustling towns, and fearsome beasts. Whether you’re a casual player checking in between meetings or a dedicated strategist optimizing every resource, there’s something here for you.

In a land threatened by the encroaching Shadow Plague, you arise as a budding hero. Start your adventure by gathering simple resources—wood from mystical groves, ore from subterranean caverns, and herbs from enchanted meadows. Level up your skills in farming, crafting, combat, and more, unlocking powerful abilities and crafting ever-mightier gear. Forge alliances with town NPCs, undertake quests, and unravel the secrets of Aradia’s lost kingdoms.

Key Features

  • Deep Skill-Based Progression
    Master over a dozen unique skills (Woodcutting, Farming, Herblore, Smithing, Hunting, Diplomacy, Exploration, and more). Each has its own upgrade paths, rare resource tiers, and achievement tracks.

  • Idle & Active Gameplay
    Earn resources and experience even when you’re away. Return to blossoming farms, smelted bars, and automated gathering. Then dive back in for active crafting, combat encounters, and world events.

  • Expansive World Map
    Explore a hand-crafted map of Aradia’s regions—from the emerald rainforests of Sylvenwood to the storm-battered coasts of Riftshore. Discover hidden landmarks, unlock fast-travel points, and conquer region-specific challenges.

  • Robust Crafting & Economy
    Combine materials at forges, alchemy tables, and workshops to craft legendary weapons, potions, and building materials. Trade with NPC merchants or set up your own stalls in town markets.

  • Dynamic Quests & Storylines
    Engage in branching questlines with meaningful choices. Ally with rival factions, defend frontier settlements, and make decisions that reshape the fate of Aradia.

  • Strategic Combat Encounters
    Face off against creatures a step above the ordinary—giant elk, ancient bisons, shadow wyrms, and more. Customize your combat build with gear sets, skill synergies, and tactical potions.

  • Community & Leaderboards
    Compare your idle efficiency, crafting prowess, and combat achievements with friends and fellow adventurers. Seasonal events and limited-time challenges keep the competition fresh.

  • Charming Pixel Art & Soundtrack
    Lose yourself in a vibrant pixel-art aesthetic, accompanied by an original orchestral-inspired soundtrack that brings every region to life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core (Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11-compatible GPU with ≥ 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz quad-core (Intel Core i5-3570K / AMD FX-8350)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12-compatible GPU with ≥ 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

short_description: Tales of Aradia is an enchanting idle RPG in a vibrant pixel-art world—harvest magical resources, master diverse skills, craft epic gear, and face mythical creatures as you uncover the secrets of a realm on the brink of darkness.
